workDescription: **Delivered:** Multimodal AI workflow converting clinical reports/images into structured datasets, retrieval inputs, model prompts, and evaluation artifacts.
**Impact:** Made model behavior measurable through diagnosis accuracy, latency, groundedness, traceability, retrieval quality, and failure-pattern tracking.
**Research:** Built Multimodal RAG for Leishmaniasis Diagnosis with 121-case retrieval corpus and 56-case held-out test set; Gemma4 RAG reached 82.6% diagnosis accuracy (+6.7 pp).
**Tech:** Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face, FastAPI, Qdrant/FAISS, PostgreSQL, Docker, Linux, Git, prompt/evaluation workflows.
